content.area.counting-room.name: 账房
content.cast.lock-it-away.clerk.0.bark.0: 进四十捆，出三十一捆。那几行是我自己写的。
content.cast.lock-it-away.clerk.0.bark.1: 账本到了夜里，就换[[obfuscated|别的什么人]]来记。
content.cast.lock-it-away.clerk.0.bark.2: 钥匙带在身上。不管我说什么，都别还给我。
content.class.runner.blurb: 商号里的跑腿。带着面包，不带武器。
content.class.runner.name: 跑腿
content.dlg.clerk.clerk-ask.opt.0.label: 给我钥匙。
content.dlg.clerk.clerk-ask.text: “账本我已经放进窗下的箱子里了。拿上钥匙，把箱子锁好，今晚把钥匙带在身上。只要没人能打开账本，就没人能在里面写字。我也不行。”
content.dlg.clerk.clerk-line.opt.0.label: 你需要什么？
content.dlg.clerk.clerk-line.text: “今天早上写的是[[color=dark_red|已结清，再无欠款。]]我这屋里只备黑墨水。再说，根本没人付过我们一分钱。”
content.dlg.clerk.clerk-root.opt.0.label: 上面写了什么？
content.dlg.clerk.clerk-root.opt.1.label: 你需要什么？
content.dlg.clerk.clerk-root.text: “你们就是商号派来的跑腿。很好。我是托宾·黑尔，这间屋子的账本归我管。每天早晨，最后一页的页脚都会多出一行。那行是我的笔迹，但不是我写的。”
content.fx.lock-it-away.done.0.narrate: 钥匙转了两圈。账本今晚就留在箱子里。
content.npc.clerk.name: 托宾·黑尔
content.obj.lock-it-away.lock-the-ledger.hint: 手里拿着箱子钥匙，对桌子后面、窗户底下的箱子使用。
content.obj.lock-it-away.lock-the-ledger.missing: 锁需要钥匙。把箱子钥匙拿在手里。
content.obj.lock-it-away.lock-the-ledger.title: 把[[bold|账本]]锁进箱子
content.obj.the-night-entries.hear-the-clerk.hin: 他站在长桌后面，面对着你。
content.quest.lock-it-away.goal: 用账房先生的钥匙把账本锁进窗下的箱子，钥匙自己留着。
content.quest.the-night-entries.goal: 听账房先生把话说完：每天早晨，账本页脚都会多出一行不是他写的字，他想把账本锁起来过夜。
content.world.outro: 账本今晚锁在箱子里，钥匙留在你身上。
content.world.title: 撞了邪的账房先生

source.area.counting-room.name: The Counting-Room
source.cast.lock-it-away.clerk.0.bark.0: Forty bales in, thirty-one out. Those lines I wrote myself.
source.cast.lock-it-away.clerk.0.bark.1: The ledger is kept by [[obfuscated|someone else]] at night.
source.cast.lock-it-away.clerk.0.bark.2: Keep the key on you. Do not give it back to me, whatever I say.
source.class.runner.blurb: Errand-runner for the merchant's house. Carries bread, and no weapon.
source.class.runner.name: House Runner
source.dlg.clerk.clerk-ask.opt.0.label: Give me the key.
source.dlg.clerk.clerk-ask.text: "I have put the ledger in the chest under the window. Take the key, lock it, and keep the key on you tonight. If nobody can open the book, nobody can write in it. Not even me."
source.dlg.clerk.clerk-line.opt.0.label: What do you need?
source.dlg.clerk.clerk-line.text: "This morning it says [[color=dark_red|Paid in full. Nothing more is owed.]] I keep only black ink in this room, and nobody has paid us anything."
source.dlg.clerk.clerk-root.opt.0.label: What does it say?
source.dlg.clerk.clerk-root.opt.1.label: What do you need?
source.dlg.clerk.clerk-root.text: "You are the runners the house sent. Good. I am Tobin Hale, and I keep the ledger in this room. Every morning there is a new line at the foot of its last page. It is in my handwriting, and I did not write it."
source.fx.lock-it-away.done.0.narrate: The key turns twice. The ledger stays in the chest tonight.
source.npc.clerk.name: Tobin Hale
source.obj.lock-it-away.lock-the-ledger.hint: Hold the Chest Key and use it on the chest under the window, behind the desk.
source.obj.lock-it-away.lock-the-ledger.missing: The lock needs its key. Hold the Chest Key in your hand.
source.obj.lock-it-away.lock-the-ledger.title: Lock the [[bold|ledger]] in the chest
source.obj.the-night-entries.hear-the-clerk.hin: He stands behind the long desk, facing you.
source.quest.lock-it-away.goal: Lock the ledger in the chest under the window with the clerk's key, and keep the key.
source.quest.the-night-entries.goal: Hear the clerk out: a line he did not write appears at the foot of the ledger every morning, and he wants the book locked away for the night.
source.world.outro: The ledger stays locked in the chest tonight, and the key stays with you.
source.world.title: The Touched Clerk
